newsitem.title: UK: RJB Mining plans "clean coal" power station - paper.
newsitem.headline: RJB Mining plans "clean coal" power station - paper.

text.p: RJB Mining Plc plans to move into electricity generation using clean coal technology, a British newspaper said on Tuesday.
Richard Budge, RJB's chief executive, told the Financial Times he would detail plans for a coalfired power station on Tuesday and announce the identity of a partner in the venture.
The partner is believed to be an energy company, but not one of Britain's existing big generators or regional electricity companies, the Financial Times said.
The planned 200 MW to 500 MW station would use reserves from RJB Mining's Yorkshire coalfields, the paper said.
